sources.reviewed: Abstract and sections3.1-3.3, equations6-8 and Algorithm1; not a full appendix replication.
sources.method: ARM forms merged backbones, selects using role-conditioned activation overlap, then replaces donor-salient neurons while protecting other benchmark-salient sets. For gated MLPs, the same index links gate/up rows and down columns. Its experts share a base architecture and tokenizer.
sources.implication: Connected-neuron hard transplantation without gradient updates is existing work. No novelty claim for this operation; activity saliency alone is not our individual-neuron causal meaning criterion.

sources.reviewed: Abstract, sections3.1-3.3 and selected experiment/setup paragraphs4.1-4.2.2, including tables4-5.
sources.method: Beyond Learning copies compatible leaf linear modules selected by source/target activation discrepancy. It studies Phi-generation and Gemma2 base/instruction pairs, with no optimization after copying. Reported best configurations depend on module count and decoding budget.
sources.implication: Whole-linear replacement and Gemma transplantation already have direct priors. Best-setting tables do not authorize a winning module/dose search in our frozen assay. This is not evidence for Gemma4 coding gains or our fixed128-neuron addition.
